About

Lack and Longing

You are invited to explore why we want what we want. This guide brings together psychoanalysis, philosophy, contemplative traditions, and the wisdom of the body to ask the questions a curious newcomer might ask, and to offer answers you can read slowly.

The guide is laid out as a road with seven neighborhoods, each exploring one part of desire. Start wherever your curiosity leads. Every entry opens with a short summary, followed by questions and answers. Each answer ends with a question for you to bring into your own life.

If you would rather read a story, Story Mode follows a Traveler and an Oracle down the same road, one house at a time.

Take what is useful, leave what is not, and go at your own pace.

Story Mode

A dialogue in seven houses along a road. A Traveler carries a question down the road, and an Oracle takes him into each house, one neighborhood at a time.
